question: The Sun Temple at Konark was built under the rule of which dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eastern Ganga Dynasty**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Sun Temple at Konark, also known as the Black Pagoda, was built by King Narasimhadeva I of the **Eastern Ganga Dynasty** in the 13th century.
 
• The temple is an architectural marvel and is designed in the shape of a colossal chariot with elaborately carved stone wheels, pillars, and walls.<
